title: REQ · An engine helper plays the scene's authored fade with its content duration
summary: playSceneTransition(ctx, scene) calls ctx.playTransition with the transition entry's durationMs.
description: Context: EffectSpec has a { type: 'transition', kind: 'fade', durationMs } variant (game/src/content/schema.ts L14) and SceneDef.effects holds it. Desired behavior: a pure engine helper finds the transition spec and calls ctx.playTransition(durationMs); it does nothing when absent. Expected result: the duration comes from content, never hardcoded. Why: keeps runtime separate from content.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene.effects contains a fade transition with durationMs 400, when playSceneTransition runs, then ctx.playTransition is called once with 400.
Given scene.effects is undefined or has no transition entry, when playSceneTransition runs, then ctx.playTransition is never called.
definition_of_done: Helper exported and used by BootScene
